full_judgment:
"Records need not be called for. Let a Rule be issued calling upon the opposite parties to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and order dated 1-4-2021 passed by the learned Senior District Judge, Satkhira in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 5 of 2021 allowing the same as modified way by reversing the order No. 6 dated 13-12-2020 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, Ashashuni, Satkhira in Title Suit No. 114 of 2020 rejecting the application under Section 39 Rules 1 and 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure filed by the plaintiff-appellant-opposite party No. 1 should not be set-aside and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper." 

 2. Facts leading to the issuance of the Rule are inter alia that the opposite party No. 1 being plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 114 of 2020 before the Court of the learned Assistant Judge, Ashashuni, Satkhira with the following relief: 

 12. The impugned judgment and order dated 1-4-2021 passed in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 5 of 2021 by the learned Senior District Judge, Satkhira is hereby set-aside and those of the learned Assistant Judge, Ashashuni, Satkhira passed in Title Suit No. 114 of 2020 is maintained.
